{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate conversion rate by customer_segment
# Conversion rate = proportion of converted orders within each segment
conversion_rates = completed_data.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean().round(4)

# Sort to find highest
conversion_rates_sorted = conversion_rates.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Return the segment with highest rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates_sorted.index[0]

print("Conversion rates by segment:")
print(conversion_rates_sorted)
print(f"\nSegment with highest conversion rate: {highest_segment}")"}
